steps.code:
# Now I'll identify which songs in the queue are liked and remove them.
# To avoid position shifting, I'll remove from highest position to lowest.
liked_in_queue = [(song['position'], song['song_id']) for song in queue if song['song_id'] in liked_song_ids]
print(f"Liked songs in queue: {liked_in_queue}")

# Sort by position descending so removals don't affect lower positions
liked_in_queue.sort(key=lambda x: x[0], reverse=True)
print(f"Removal order: {liked_in_queue}")
